$doc: §23.6 ST-3. The squad's slot table is AUTHORED (8 riflemen, Ammo 12: 96 rounds) because a TKB basic load lasts too long to spend in a scenario; a spare, filled stochastic squad far away is what teaches the engine each role's personal weapon (KillerVictimTkb.PersonalSoldiers is filled by the first spawn fill). The Red platoon is authored with 0 rounds, so it cannot fire back, and the company attacks it (CompanyAttack asks the squad for SITREPs). Measured: the first round goes at 1.25 s, every slot is empty at 6.25 s, the SITREP ammunition reads Red at 3.25 s and Black at 18.25 s (the report's delay).

expect.name: it fires: rounds leave the slots
it fires until the rounds are spent: every slot is empty
and then it fires no more: no firing line at the end
the SITREP ammunition reads Black at its commander
the squad is not destroyed (the Red platoon has no ammunition)
